mission: Throwaway fixture profile. It exists to prove that a generated repository satisfies every structural invariant end to end, and is deliberately not modelled on any real genre so it can never be mistaken for production taste policy.

automation_rules.past_24h_definition: Only items with added_by=daily-automation and added_at within the last 24 hours.

principles.descriptive_only: A DNA value describes how strongly a property exists in a TITLE. It never states whether that property is desirable. Desirability lives only in dna_baseline and dna_guardrails.
principles.unknown_is_not_zero: Missing or null means UNKNOWN, never 'definitely absent'. Never substitute 0.
principles.unknown_never_satisfies: A threshold comparison against an unknown value is false in both directions. Unknown can never satisfy a positive or a negative test.
principles.unknown_is_not_safe: Unknown must not be read as 'passes the guardrail'. An item is not DNA-score-eligible unless every dimension referenced ANYWHERE in dna_guardrails is known - hard_exclusion and combination alike.
principles.independent_dimensions: action_intensity and action_density are separate information and must never be combined, averaged or substituted for one another: intensity is how hard the action hits when it happens, density is how much of the runtime it occupies. Likewise visual_quality (craft) and retro_visual_style (era aesthetic) are independent - a title may be excellent AND strongly old-school, and release year is never an input to either.

rubric.10: the whole structure is a mystery

rubric.0: essentially no action across the runtime
rubric.3: a few isolated action scenes in an otherwise inactive runtime
rubric.5: action recurs regularly, roughly a third of the runtime
rubric.8: action occupies most of the runtime

rubric.5: ordinary force and stakes when action occurs
rubric.10: peak sequences are extreme in force, scale and stakes
the invented world is deep, consistent and load-bearing
exceptional craft - judged on its own presentation, never on release year
strongly retro, legacy or old-school aesthetic - judged from colour grading, lensing, editing rhythm, effects technique and design language, NEVER from the release date
military institutions, operations or combat framing dominates

rubric.5: costumed or superpowered hero structure present

dna_baseline.description: The desired CONTENT universe expressed on the DNA scale. Stable baseline. Accumulated user feedback is NEVER merged into this section.
dna_baseline.unweighted_note: pace_speed is meaningful only in combination. superhero is hard-excluded, and a dimension handled by a HARD exclusion is never also weighted - that would penalise it twice, once by removing the item and once by lowering a score it no longer has.

completeness_defaults.note: An item must satisfy ALL THREE conditions to be scored by the DNA path. required_known_dimensions must contain every dimension referenced ANYWHERE in dna_guardrails, so an item can never pass a structural guardrail or dodge a combination penalty merely because the relevant dimension is unknown. retro_visual_style is required despite no guardrail referencing it: it carries a load-bearing negative weight, so leaving it unmeasured would quietly favour untested titles.

dna_baseline.archetype_note: Scoring takes the BEST-matching archetype, never an average. Every emphasis and penalise dimension must be weighted or required-known, or bestArchetype() would throw on an item that never measured it.

dna_guardrails.description: Policy applied to descriptive DNA measurements. Not learnable away by ordinary feedback.
dna_guardrails.evaluation_note: A condition whose dimension is unknown/null evaluates FALSE. hard_exclusion entries remove the item from DNA-scored results AND are enforced at ingestion by validate.mjs, because the plain watch rows do not consult DNA and would otherwise publish an excluded title anyway. combination entries apply a score penalty and never remove an item on their own.

hard_exclusion.note: Excludes on a value being too HIGH. Superhero structure is central, not merely a powered character appearing.

Excludes on a value being too LOW - the definitional floor this fixture exists to exercise. A title with a handful of action scenes across an otherwise inactive runtime does not belong in an action-shaped addon however good its other properties are. The same title may qualify normally in a differently-shaped profile.

combination.note: Military framing is fine when something else is driving the story; this fires only when it is not.
Craft, not age. retro_visual_style is deliberately NOT referenced here: a strongly old-school look softens ranking through its linear weight and must never exclude or heavily penalise on its own.
Slow is not bad; slow WITHOUT anything pulling the viewer forward is.

execution_preferences.description: Baseline POLICY for how execution evidence is applied. Policy only. Accumulated feedback is NEVER written here.
rules: Execution feedback never changes topic or DNA eligibility.
Concept feedback may refine content preference, conservatively and preferably on repeated independent evidence.
Tone feedback is a soft ranking adjustment and never a hard subject blacklist.
A single title never establishes a generalised content aversion.
The stable baseline remains dominant while feedback history is small.

preference_notes.soft_actor_affinity_rule: METADATA, outside Content DNA, with NO ELIGIBILITY EFFECT. It may be consulted only after normal content scoring and every guardrail have already qualified a title, and only as a deterministic sort tie-break among titles whose scores are already equal (item.tie_break_rank). It must never alter descriptive DNA, lift a failing title over the threshold, cancel a guardrail, overcome low action density, substitute for content research, or propagate to another profile.

baseline_evidence.description: Audit trail for how the weights above were derived. NOT read at runtime by the scorer: the weights, archetypes and guardrails ARE the encoding of this evidence. Watched entries may never be recommended again; unwatched entries stay fully eligible and must earn their place through ordinary research and scoring.
